## Out of scope, on purpose

7 paths are never labelled, moved, or archived — product state, secrets, nested repos and caches (9,465 files, 397 MB). Largest:
- `.venv/` — virtualenv (regenerable)
- `.uv-cache/` — package cache (regenerable)
- `__pycache__/` — bytecode cache (regenerable)
- `scoreboard/__pycache__/` — bytecode cache (regenerable)
- `tools/__pycache__/` — bytecode cache (regenerable)
- *(full list with reasons: [FILES.md](workflow/curation/FILES.md))*

## Keeping this true

```
python ~/.claude/skills/curate/curate.py run    --project <abs repo path>   # regenerate this map + FILES + scorecard
python ~/.claude/skills/curate/curate.py check  --project <abs repo path>   # exit 1 on drift (advisory, never a commit gate)
python ~/.claude/skills/curate/curate.py verify --project <abs repo path>   # archive fixity + seeded spot check
```
Hand-written material (`descriptions.json`, `rules.json`, the registers, the question bank) survives regeneration; generated files must never be hand-edited. Nothing is ever deleted: superseded material is marked in place or bagged, and retirement is a separate gated step. Re-score the question bank after any documentation change.
